name: Sykes
description: Classic sitcom starring Eric Sykes and Hattie Jacques as brother and sister twins who have to tackle the trials and tribulations of suburban life.

videos.title: Sykes in the Studio - Part 1
videos.overview: DVD Extra - Sykes in the Studio, outtakes and cut scenes plus interview with Eric Sykes.

videos.title: Sykes in the Studio - Part 2
videos.overview: DVD Extra - Sykes in the Studio, outtakes and cut scenes plus interview with Eric Sykes.

videos.title: Sykes in the Studio - Part 3
videos.overview: DVD Extra - Sykes in the Studio, outtakes and cut scenes plus interview with Eric Sykes.

videos.title: Burglary
videos.overview: A series of burglaries misses the Sykes household and Mr Brown is the first to point out that they can have nothing worth stealing. Eric counters by saying he has a dog; but when he does buy one his troubles really begin.

videos.title: Uncle
videos.overview: Eric is in his neighbour's black books, an embarassing affair at the golf club guest-night having affected his status. But when Eric reveals his uncle's identity Mr Brown attitude suddenly changes.

videos.title: Walk
videos.overview: When Eric takes up walking he soon begins to think big. Mr Brown is not easily convinced of his abilities, so Eric decides to walk to Brighton.

videos.title: Menace
videos.overview: Amanda, aged ten, arrives to stay for a weekend. Painfully recalling her sister's love of practical jokes Eric can't believe she's as innocent as she looks.

videos.title: Boat
videos.overview: Mr Brown is persuaded to lend his new boat to Eric, who finds navigation harder than talking about the South China Seas.

videos.title: Stranger
videos.overview: Eric and Hattie are visted by a stranger who has returned to honour a childhood promise.

videos.title: Football
videos.overview: The local football team needs a referee - kindly but firm, worthy of respect. They choose Eric.

videos.title: Job
videos.overview: Eric abandons domestic chores to join Hattie at the local factory.

videos.title: Ankle
videos.overview: As Eric takes out the rubbish to the dustbin a gust of wind distributes it on to Mr Brown's footpath.

videos.title: Mouse
videos.overview: Eric and Hattie are alarmed to find that they have a mouse in the house. Eric tries several ways of getting rid of it but none succeed and he has to call in the big guns.

videos.title: Dream
videos.overview: After being bitten by a dog Eric consults his doctor and is suddenly afflicted by a less easily treated malady.

videos.title: Marriage
videos.overview: When Hattie advertises for some eligible bachelors Eric realises that without her his life would be difficult.

videos.title: Cat
videos.overview: Hattie gets a kitten and Eric ends up looking for tiddles on a roof belonging to Major Crombie-Crombie - who hates cats.

videos.title: Journey
videos.overview: Eric and Hattie, after a holiday in Scotland with Mr Brown, speed home on the Glasgow night sleeper and end up in Darlington.

videos.title: Lodger
videos.overview: Mr Brown has the decorators in and decides to stay next door with Eric and Hattie.

videos.title: Cafe
videos.overview: Eric buys a transport cafe, turns it into a smart roadhouse and loses customers. To do well Eric must makes things more earthy.

videos.title: An Engagement
videos.overview: Eric nurses a hangover following an army reunion, but receives a surprise when a beautiful girl appears on his doorstep

videos.title: Bus
videos.overview: Eric and Hattie fail to impress the depot manager when they try to run a bus like an airline in their attempt to revolutionise London Transport. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques and Eric Sykes

videos.title: Spy Ring
videos.overview: Eric and Hattie become suspicious of their vodka-swilling, well-off new neighbours. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques

videos.title: Golf
videos.overview: Eric gets a surprise when Hattie joins him on the golf course, and ends up coaching the greats of the game

videos.title: Rolls
videos.overview: Eric becomes a chauffeur for Lady Dorothy, but his driving skills are not up to scratch

videos.title: Peeping Tom
videos.overview: Eric gets his head stuck between some railings. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques

videos.title: Fancy Dress
videos.overview: Eric arrives at a fancy dress ball dressed as Julius Caesar

videos.title: Window Smasher
videos.overview: Eric's neighbours suffer at the hands of a mystery window smasher who chooses to leave the Sykes residence intact

videos.title: Gamble
videos.overview: Eric receives advice on how he might improve his fortune, but the arrival of a gangster causes trouble

videos.title: Uniform
videos.overview: Eric and Hattie have a run-in with the police. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques

videos.title: Bird
videos.overview: Hattie give Eric an ultimatum about his new feathered friend

videos.title: Protest
videos.overview: Eric is outraged by plans to build a new block of flats in Sebastopol Terrace

videos.title: Salesman
videos.overview: Eric becomes an encyclopaedia salesman, but his techniques fail to impress the neighbours

videos.title: Haunting
videos.overview: Hattie and Eric are keen to find out what their famous uncle has left them in his will

videos.title: Nest Egg
videos.overview: Eric worries his domestic bliss will be ruined by Hattie's new boyfriend

videos.title: The Stolen Bentley
videos.overview: The sibling's plans to impress an important dinner guest are interrupted when a vintage vehicle crashes into their living room. Comedy, starring Hattie Jacques and Eric Sykes

videos.title: Holiday in Bogsea
videos.overview: Eric tries to liven up his tedious holiday in Bogsea and ends up in all sorts of trouble. Comedy, starring Hattie Jacques and Eric Sykes

videos.title: The Pub
videos.overview: The siblings take over a quiet pub for the evening, but Constable Turnbull's intervention soon has the bar buzzing with activity. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques and Eric Sykes

videos.title: The Band
videos.overview: The siblings take on a new lodger, but the police are forced to intervene when his musical enthusiasm proves to be a headache for the neighbourhood. Bernard Bresslaw guest stars

videos.title: Two Birthdays
videos.overview: Hattie takes driving lessons when Eric buys a second-hand car for her birthday. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques and Eric Sykes

videos.title: A Bandage
videos.overview: Hattie practises first aid skills on her brother, leaving him bandaged up to the hilt - and unable to get to the shops to make the final payment on his motorcycle. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques, Eric Sykes and Richard Wattis

videos.title: Log Cabin
videos.overview: The siblings decide to get away from it all for the weekend, but their hopes of a riverside retreat are dashed when they find they are not the only ones with a booking. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques, Eric Sykes and Richard Wattis

videos.title: The Fog
videos.overview: A stranger arrives at the Sykes' house, and when it turns out that he and Eric have met before, a trip down memory lane ensues

videos.title: Commercial
videos.overview: The siblings are persuaded to appear in a commercial when they pop into a hardware store. Comedy, starring Eric Sykes and Hattie Jacques

videos.title: Ski-ing
videos.overview: The hapless siblings join Corky for a Bavarian holiday, but when Eric refuses to go skiing the locals take offence. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques, Eric Sykes and Derek Guyler

videos.title: Caravan
videos.overview: Eric and Hattie regale Corky with tales of their Scottish holiday, which allegedly did wonders for the tourist trade. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques, Eric Sykes and Deryck Guyler

videos.title: Reporter
videos.overview: When Eric lands a job on the local paper he is sent to interview a rather reticent author, and wonders if his piece will make the front page. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques and Eric Sykes

videos.title: Marriage
videos.overview: When Eric sets up a business with Madge from the baker's shop, he soon learns her plans involve a great deal more than simply making doughnuts. Vintage comedy, starring Eric Sykes and Hattie Jacques

videos.title: Night Out
videos.overview: Eric's lack of domestic finesse leaves his sister quaking at the prospect of leaving him alone, but he soon has plenty to think about when Madge turns up with romance on her mind. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques and Eric Sykes

videos.title: Christmas Party
videos.overview: Eric and Hattie spend Christmas day at Corky's and are surprised by his dysfunctional family. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques, Eric Sykes and Richard Wattis

videos.title: Home Movies
videos.overview: Eric gets his hands on a movie camera and the new toy fires his ambitions to become a documentary film-maker. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques, Eric Sykes and Deryck Guyler

videos.title: Fishing
videos.overview: Eric and Hattie go fishing while on holiday at the seaside. Comedy, starring Eric Sykes and Hattie Jacques

videos.title: Lodgers
videos.overview: Corky takes advantage of his wife's spell in hospital to make some money taking in lodgers. Comedy, starring Deryck Guyler and Eric Sykes

videos.title: Holiday Camp
videos.overview: Eric is unhappy about Hattie's choice of holiday, until a blonde Redcoat brightens up his day

videos.title: Inventions
videos.overview: Eric, to everyones frustration, has found a skill for madcap inventions.

videos.title: Flashback
videos.overview: Eric regales his neighbour with tall stories about his recent holiday in Scotland, although the truth turns out to be rather different. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques, Eric Sykes and Richard Wattis

videos.title: Squatters
videos.overview: The siblings discover a tramp has moved in when they leave the front door ajar and must find a way to get rid of him. Comedy, starring Eric Sykes and Hattie Jacques

videos.title: Bath
videos.overview: Eric uses his neighbour's bathroom while his is being decorated, but when he gets his toe stuck in the bath tap his fate is in the hands of the emergency services. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques and Eric Sykes

videos.title: Sykes At Christmas
videos.overview: Eric and Hattie celebrate the festive season with special guest stars Jimmy Edwards and Sylvia Peters

videos.title: The Hypnotist
videos.overview: A stage hypnotist soon has an unbelieving Eric performing all kinds of antics.

videos.title: Picket Line
videos.overview: Eric tries to strike a blow for the common people - but his chants against inflation take a downward turn. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques, Eric Sykes and Richard Wattis

videos.title: Football Match
videos.overview: Eric works out a plan to get the day off work to watch a football match.

videos.title: Decorating
videos.overview: The siblings argue about doing the decorating with Hattie wishing to hire a professional but Eric wanting to have a go himself - with disastrous consequences. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques, Eric Sykes and Richard Wattis

videos.title: End of the World
videos.overview: The siblings and neighbours congregate on Shepherd's Hill to wait for the end of the world - but as night falls, everyone makes the most of the moment. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques, Eric Sykes and Richard Wattis

videos.title: Television Film
videos.overview: Eric begins to act like Cecil B DeMille when the BBC decides to come and film in his garden. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques and Eric Sykes

videos.title: The Drop Out
videos.overview: Eric and Hattie put a close friend's nephew up for a few days - but when they arrive home, all they find is a guitar, a syringe and a pair of eyes staring up from the cellar

videos.title: Fanny-By-Gaslight
videos.overview: A neglected Eric plans to prove to Hattie she is heading for a breakdown because of all the social work she is doing. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques and Eric Sykes

videos.title: The Stay-At-Home Holiday
videos.overview: The siblings are about to leave on holiday, so Hattie discloses the events of their previous vacation abroad. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques and Eric Sykes

videos.title: Bad Medicine
videos.overview: Eric and Hattie suffer a bout of suspected food poisoning and the doctor prescribes some tablets which produce strange side effects

videos.title: The Insurance Money
videos.overview: Eric and Hattie make good use of an insurance payment when they go on a camping holiday. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques and Eric Sykes

videos.title: Six Million Dollar Sykes
videos.overview: Eric celebrates his birthday in the local pub and ends up in hospital after a confrontation with the neighbourhood bully. Vintage comedy, starring Hattie Jacques, Eric Sykes and Richard Wattis

videos.title: The BBC Honours Sykes
videos.overview: Eric and Hattie have to attend a presentation ceremony at the BBC, but as usual chaos ensues. Last ever episode of the comedy, starring Eric Sykes and Hattie Jacques
